narrative.northStar: A considered South African home-fragrance object
narrative.overview: Approved visual authority is Figma file jIMvwSBkilg7eplo3IiHPa, page 2004:14, section 2484:736 and contracts 2484:737. Retain existing foundations. INF-33 Shop/Product and INF-34 Home/shared-shell/Cart are merged. PR74 at d6c2018 delivers combined About, Guide preferences and corrected primary button labels, with Devon's desktop/tablet/mobile approval and production smoke evidence. User-approved About viewport sizing supersedes the initial Figma full-column size. App and Storybook share actual Marcellus/Manrope fonts. Guide matching and source publication remain gated. Approved Contact under INF-27 uses centered hero text over Shop's placeholder image, centered direct-email content and full-width writing guidance on Home's gold invitation surface with the approved midnight shell. Devon approved frames 2529:2/19/37/55 on 9 September; they are promoted to Approved and implemented in runtime/Storybook under INF-35. See docs/features/inf-27-contact.md. Devon approved Guide note/character matching on 9 September. Frames 2172:2 and 2457:601/749/897 with contract 2458:676 are synchronized. Results use source-derived reasons, 1-3 actual matches, explicit equal editorial ranking and unavailable states. Other four answers are summary-only. Existing tokens reused; Sanity publication remains deferred with an accepted versioned repository snapshot. Devon subsequently requested Suggested fragrances before Your fragrance preferences. Continue focuses suggestions when available and preferences for empty/failure states; existing section styles remain. Devon selected carousel background 2727:44 on 15 September 2026; optional Sanity heroBackground controls the shared decorative image, with original Reed Shadows fallback. Crop, scrim and semantic tokens are unchanged. Devon approved INF-43 footer refinement on 16 September 2026: Approved section 2730:37, variants 2730:45/75/106/139. See docs/features/inf-43-footer.md. INF-46 input-state correction: logo and menu outlines are suppressed after pointer/touch activation; keyboard input restores existing focus-visible states. Avatar, geometry, tokens and Figma default/keyboard designs remain unchanged. On 18 September 2026 Devon requested the new Figma website master imagery. The carousel now supports up to six campaigns without geometry, token or motion changes. Devon subsequently rejected card gutters: use 1254-square outpainted masters with cover fitting in the existing square frame, preserving complete reeds and bases. Responsive editorial candidates are Figma page 2835:2, refined rows 2842:2/5/8; review and publication remain gated. Authored phone Shop/Contact/About/statement minimum heights are 220/520/600/600px, with quiet space above products. Single-picture art direction switches below 640px (Guide 1024px). See docs/features/website-imagery-refresh.md.

rules.body: User requested Manrope Semibold (600) header labels and distinct loading. Neutral 20px LoaderCircle in existing 32px slot/44px Account target, aria-busy and checking-status accessible name, reduced-motion safe. Shared layout retains verified profile in memory across client navigation; concurrent checks deduplicated. Hidden pages, logout and invalid results clear identity. rules.body: Approved Figma 2764:488 / 2764:487: 32px gold outline inside existing 44px Account target; 12px Manrope Semibold initials. Midnight default gold-500/porcelain; hover pale-gold ring and 12% accent tint; inset circular 2px keyboard focus; pressed/current account gold-500 fill with ink text. rules.body: Use DESIGN.md and docs/features/2026-09-08-design-approval.md. Historical links do not override the current Approved frames.

rules.name: Shop and product contract
rules.body: Light cards use porcelain-0, 20px display titles, 12px metadata, 15px prices and 145% line height. Product headings use 115% line height. The collection hero scrim is #191916 at 54%. Preserve growing panels and source-owned purchase states.

rules.name: Home and shared shell
rules.body: Retain all Home sections. Quiet surfaces use sage-100; invitation uses gold-300. INF-43 footer uses left-aligned brand, Explore and Contact groups, Marcellus 18/26 headings, Manrope Regular 15/24 links, 44px targets and a divided copyright row. Mobile uses two navigation columns; compact email wraps after @. Plain hero and failure frames use 5:4; square quantity controls retain 44px targets.

rules.name: About and Guide contract
rules.body: About uses stable source gallery IDs, image-only square campaign previews capped at min(400px,50svh), centered with cover fitting per Devon's 17 September refinement; a dedicated conceptual landscape hero (2160×720 WebP) with 40% scrim; full source photographs in the viewer and captioned 16:9/4:3 market figures. Guide answer surface #F7F3EA, border rgb(132 101 35 / 55%), number ink #846523 map to semantic roles. Verify actual loaded fonts before screenshots. Primary button material must stay behind all label content, including plain-text links. Guide sample rankings remain Storybook-only.

rules.name: Editorial carousel and floating navigation
rules.body: 12 September approved Figma composition 2664:2 and mobile 2674:22: 64px header, uppercase Manrope, close underline, 44px account/bag/menu controls, transparent Home header until scrollY > 24 then midnight. Shared reed-shadow background; manual synchronized title/subtitle/CTA/image slides, 520/600 desktop columns, 5:4 media, mobile stack. Preserve existing tokens and conditional commerce links. See docs/features/carousel-navigation.md. Follow-up: share the site-wide max-1440 container, 20/24/40/64px gutters and minimum 100svh hero height; vertically center and grow for long content. Next translates right-to-left and Previous reverses, 600ms ease-in-out without fading; reduced motion is instant. Desktop arrows use outer-gutter midpoints. Scrolled header has a 1px navigation-divider rule without height change.

rules.name: Consolidated delivery
rules.body: PR #83 includes current component governance and interim Contact enquiry defaults. Solid navigation retains its gold divider; floating Home navigation shows gold only after scroll. Mobile keyboard order follows visual order: home, account, cart, menu. Preserve INF-28/31 deferrals and human release gates. See docs/design-implementation.md.

rules.name: Navigation breathing room
rules.body: Shared --navigation-height is 80px desktop (1024px+) and 72px below. Existing logo sizes stay. Menu header and hero offset share the token; solid border is inside the height. Supersedes earlier 64px header.

rules.name: Carousel autoplay and laptop clearance
rules.body: 86px desktop / 78px mobile navigation. Editorial slides rotate every 6s with pause/play, manual/focus pause and hover/visibility protections. Reduced-motion/save-data/loading disable autoplay. Laptop 1024–1535px hero insets 96px leave 42px arrow clearance; mobile/wide gutters unchanged. Moving stage edges use a 24px alpha fade; stationary media is crisp.

rules.name: Carousel viewport fit
rules.body: 12 September correction: preserve width-driven 5:4 campaign frames at every viewport, aligned to Figma 2674:31 (342 x 273.6). Use contain fitting to show complete source images without distortion or cropping; portrait images have side space. Let short screens scroll. Supersedes viewport-dependent media heights. Keep text and 44px targets. Counter is 11px gold below the image, with no separate icon. Image border is 1px semantic gold. Phone headlines below 640px use 30px type and 36px line height. Phone descriptions use 15px/24px; CTA labels use 12px with unchanged 48px button height.

rules.name: Phone hero alignment
rules.body: 15 September user refinement: below 640px center editorial slide headings, descriptions and CTA buttons. At 640px and above retain left alignment. Preserve 5:4 contained imagery, gutters, controls and motion.

rules.name: Header label refinement — 17 September 2026
rules.body: Devon approved source-label casing, normal letter spacing and navigation-muted for desktop and mobile menu links, matching footer links (midnight #E8E2D5). Use header-only semibold (600) weight per Devon's follow-up, preserving antialiased font smoothing; footer weight stays regular (400). Keep Manrope, existing sizes, gold active underline, focus, geometry and utility icons. This supersedes uppercase styling in the historical Figma captures 2664:2, 2665:7 and 2675:27 as an intentional user-approved divergence. Runtime tokens are unchanged; Navigation stories share the updated component.

dos: Do verify changed components and consuming pages against exact approved frames at 1440, 768, 390 and 320 where supplied.
Do preserve source-owned content and existing commerce behavior.
